pros: Generous limits: four hours for the half, 90 minutes for the 5 km
Nine water stations on the half, plus sponge and dousing points
A 12-week beginner training plan shared by the race manager
cons: Places sell out in minutes: the first 3,000 went in five minutes in 2025
Undulating loop with 104 m of climbing
Very humid: 94% to 100% humidity around the 2025 start
Prize money for Indonesian citizens only; no refunds or transfers
name: Arutmin Borneo Run 2026
short_description: Arutmin Borneo Run 2026 is a road race in Banjarbaru, South Kalimantan, on Sunday 1 November 2026, over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon.
ai_summary: Arutmin Borneo Run 2026 is a road race held in Banjarbaru, South Kalimantan, on Sunday 1 November 2026. It offers three distances -- 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon -- and is organised by IdeaRun. It is one of the few races of any size in South Kalimantan, a province with little on the national running calendar.

core_facts.venue: Halaman Kantor Gubernur Kalimantan Selatan (South Kalimantan Governor's Office grounds), Banjarbaru

faqs.question: When is Arutmin Borneo Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Sunday 1 November 2026, in Banjarbaru, South Kalimantan. Indonesian road races start before dawn to avoid the heat, so expect a very early flag-off and plan transport to the start the night before rather than on the morning.

faqs.question: What distances does Arutmin Borneo Run 2026 offer?
faqs.answer: Three: 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The half marathon is the headline distance, and the shorter races are aimed at newer runners and those who want a faster morning. Entry fees and cut-off times are set by the organiser, so check the official registration page before entering.
